facts.fact: bpy.data.objects.new does not put the object in any scene
an unlinked object is not evaluated (not in the depsgraph)
scene.collection.objects.link(obj) puts it in the scene's master collection
with factory empty startup, bpy.context.collection is the scene collection
linking the same object twice into one collection raises
facts.error: RuntimeError: Error: Object 'lonely' already in collection 'Scene Collection'

facts.fact: a new collection is not in the scene until linked under scene.collection.children
an object can be in several collections at once
unlinking from one collection leaves it in the others
scene.objects lists objects from all nested collections

in the viewport depsgraph (what evaluated_depsgraph_get() returns in -b): layer_collection.exclude removes it, collection.hide_viewport removes it, collection.hide_render keeps it, obj.hide_set(True) removes it
obj.hide_get()/hide_set() are per view layer; obj.hide_viewport and obj.hide_render are global flags
move = unlink from every users_collection, then link to the target
an Empty with instance_type COLLECTION instances that collection's objects (seen in depsgraph.object_instances)
